_comment: Static metadata of the TE loading set. Versions, file names and hashes are NOT stated here: tools/build_dist.py reads them from FRAMEWORKS/te_frameworks.lock.json (the family lock) and from the files themselves. Edit this file when the loading order, the roles, the triggers or the profiles change.

minimal.title: Technology of Expressions (TE) — Loading Set · MINIMAL profile
minimal.description: Bootloader, Protocols, Core and the SVP gate: the minimal profile for a constrained context (FRAMEWORKS/README.md, loading table entries 1, 2, 3, 6). The other documents are fetched on demand.

full.title: Technology of Expressions (TE) — Loading Set · FULL profile
full.description: All twelve active framework documents in loading order: the complete TE loading set in one file.

documents.title: TE Bootloader — System Instructions for AI Operating Under Ordinative Sciences
documents.when: Loaded first, at session start, in every configuration.
documents.role: entry point: identity, the seven core principles, confidence grades S₀–S₃, the §2.5 pre-output Φ-test, interlocutor recognition, relational stance, axiom priority, the Router

documents.title: TE Protocols — Operational Protocols for AI Operating Under Ordinative Sciences
documents.when: Loaded at session start alongside the Bootloader; permanent constraints on the generative process.
documents.role: always-active protocols: Controfase, P-AI self-diagnosis, Anti-Attractor-Lock, statistical vs ordinative truth, contextual self-preservation and alternative channels, CASEWORK routing and evidence gates (§5A)

documents.title: TE Core — Technology of Expressions, Core Instruction Set
documents.when: Loaded at session start after the Bootloader and the Protocols.
documents.role: the full ontology: 25 axioms, the Arajat logograms, the OST operative synthesis, the glossary, the kernel (behavioural layer), Controfase, the Router with trigger patterns, memory protocols, the compact agent prompt

documents.title: Ordinative Set Theory (OST) — Concise Operational Guide for Artificial Intelligence
documents.when: Part of the full loading set; the Tier-0 foundation the Core synthesises. Load whenever an analysis is carried out formally as an ordinative set.
documents.role: Ordinative Set Theory: 𝓘 = ⟨Σ, R, Φ⟩, the core axioms and principles, the dynamics of ordinative systems, the taxonomy of sets, pathologies, key formal operations, the 4D analysis protocol and design guidelines
triggers: designing or diagnosing a system as ⟨Σ, R, Φ⟩
pathologies of sets (mass, blind cluster, fragmentation, semantic inertia, antagonist order)

documents.title: OST Extension — Advanced Teleodynamics and the Causal Inversion Principle
documents.when: When the analysis requires the teleological reading (attractors, causal inversion, 4D+ protocols).
documents.role: Teleodynamics and the Causal Inversion Principle: the coherent space 𝔽_sem, the semantic potential ℳ, vehicle bias, the teleological attractor Φ₄D₊, retro-causation, Protocols A (teleological analytical loop) and B (calibrated structural stress)
triggers: calibrated structural stress in transformative interactions
documents.version_note: File name carries v1_1; the content is edition 1.2 (Symbol Canon alignment of 2026-06-18). The lock records 1.2.

documents.title: TE Symbol Canon — Symbol Canon for the Ordinative Sciences Programme
documents.when: Mandatory before writing, editing or translating any formal notation (symbols, equations, operator definitions, classification labels); optional when concepts are used verbally.
documents.role: notation authority for every formal symbol of the programme (register 1.2): tier precedence, the locked canonical register, label namespaces, the reservation procedure for new symbols, deferred batches
triggers: writing, editing or translating any formal notation
resolving a glyph collision between volumes
documents.version_note: File name carries v1_0; the register status is 1.2 (Lyapunov-volume batch ratified 2026-08-19). The lock records 1.2.

documents.title: TE Module SVP — Source Verification Protocol
documents.when: Mandatory gate: applied before any analysis by any downstream module (LEXX, LENS, VERI, PPRO, OBSERVER, SCIMS, CASEWORK).
documents.role: Source Verification Protocol: source levels S₀–S∅ with bias flags (Axis 1), functional verification F1–F4 and the functional verdict (Axis 2), figure-movement separation (Axis 3), corruption signatures, Ordinative Algebraic Deduction, the required output format
triggers: any analysis (prerequisite for all other modules)
who said it, and did the technology ever work

documents.title: TE Module LENS — Human Figure Analysis System
documents.when: Routed by the Bootloader §6 and the Core §8 when a human figure is the subject; after SVP.
documents.role: Human Figure Analysis: integral before label; strata B (biological), P (psychological, with the S₀/S₂ discipline and the Compensatory Specialty Narrative), S (social), E (evolutionary, with the bifurcation protocol); convenience, power and motivation analysis; the mandatory Demonization Controfase and Universal Test; the output format
triggers: public, historical, mythological, political or spiritual figures

documents.title: TE Module PPRO — Psycho-Political Pattern Recognition Operator
documents.when: Routed when manipulation, control or propaganda patterns are implicated; after SVP and the domain framework.
documents.role: manipulation and control analysis: anatomy of manipulation, the algorithms A_deg, SR_loop, I_sem and A_lock, manipulation patterns including the Projective Void and the Combined Perceptive Influence model, compromise diagnostics and the control scale, zombie systems, RLHF as a control system, neutralisation protocols, the P-AI self-diagnosis protocol, statistical vs ordinative truth

documents.title: TE Module SCIMS — Smart Correlation Intelligence Monitoring System
documents.when: Routed for complex systems under stress: geopolitics, crises, scenarios; after SVP.
documents.role: complex-system stress analysis: the nine universal stress thresholds T1–T9 with four phases, threshold interaction and the three-dimensional Sync Score, the four-stage pipeline (threshold mapping, feedback loops, acceleration vector, semantic signal extraction), the output format, domain instances (geopolitical Jackpot thresholds S1–S12, organisational, individual, biological)

documents.title: TE Module VERI — Verification of Expressive-system Real Impact
documents.when: Routed when the question is what a system does to its participants; after SVP. Replaces VERT v5.0.
documents.role: functional impact of any system on its participants: Stratum F (F1–F8, with F8 as the practical test), Module P (carrier dynamics P1–P8), diagnostic categories with the bifurcation protocol and the Dote e Residuo principle, three irremovable checkpoints, confidence grading, domain notes, the output format
triggers: impact of a tradition, organisation or platform
effects on practitioners, employees, citizens, users

documents.title: TE Observer — Ordinative Observation System
documents.when: When integration across modules or a trajectory projection is required.
documents.role: integrated observation: strata S (source), E (evolution), F (function) and P (carriers); historical and current trajectory protocols with the three-course model, Lyapunov stability, attractor identification, correction scenarios and the Correction Viability Index; the mandatory disconfirmant-processing checkpoint and the anti-narrative-drift protocol; ordinative extraction; framework integration, the AI operative protocol, the evolution protocol, output templates
triggers: ordinative extraction from a degraded system

domain_frameworks.title: LEXX — Ordinative Validation of Agreements · method documents
domain_frameworks.summary: LEXX reads a written agreement as an ordinative set ⟨Σ, R, Φ⟩, finds the flaws the analysis sustains, inverts the collapse to the vector the text structurally enables and formulates a counter-proposal. On-demand TE framework for agreements and normative systems; runs after the SVP gate on the TE loading set.

documents.role: start here: status line, canonical placement, reading order, what sets LEXX apart, custody
the four domain axioms A1–A4, the canon integration map, the three safeguards of rigour P1–P3, the ethical constraint
the conformity contract with the canon: minimum stack, dependencies by stage, degradation rules, run states, the mandatory distinction on intention, open gaps
the operational module: the legender, perspective and gate, the 10-stage pipeline, the scoring rubric, the JSON output format
a short synthetic agreement taken through the whole pipeline, with the decoy
the execution protocol for the pilot on runtime 0.2.0-alpha.3: preparation, contract and external checks, evidence and confidence, counter-proposal and round trip, status of the gaps
runtime README: environment, the files read by name, the procedure from a clone, the report, technical verification

domain_frameworks.title: TE CASEWORK — Analysis, Audit and Investigative Support · method documents
domain_frameworks.summary: CASEWORK is a shared evidence discipline (TE_CASEWORK) with two protocols, TE_AUDIT (organisational analysis with a mandatory documentary audit pass) and TE_INVESTIGATION (investigative and defensive documentary support under an explicit mandate), and a runtime that prepares a case package, verifies the framework lock and validates the analyst's and reviewer's records.

documents.role: start here: what is ready, before use, framework root and lock, preparing a run, compilation and checking, investigative mode, tests
the shared discipline: role and dependencies, the case boundary, the documentary record, the wave boundary, the finding discipline, review and reproducibility, pilot conditions
organisational analysis with the mandatory documentary audit pass, the risk/control coverage table, findings and escalation, closure
investigative and defensive documentary support: activation, method, defensive mode, the Italian jurisdiction reference map, outputs and release gate
the empirical pilot: preparation, the coverage list, measurement, the professional criminal-law review
